boundaries: Source assignment, private ordinary arguments and RETURN; compatible user STRUCTURE roots and record ARRAY terminals
schemas: Identical field-name sets; recursive receiver names/order, bounded STRING/numeric fields and matching logical ARRAY layout; no generic helper relaxation
preflight: Declared source schema and known domains; output bounds before allocation; all context-free conversions and complete finite proper model operands before first adapter
order: Receiver field declaration order, depth-first; logical row-major ARRAY cells; all source operands captured before first model call
models: Explicit scalar model/adapters, root-caller group, current frame/tool and inverse seed at each call; no previous-field seed or silent robot-state update
publication: Entire output staged privately; failures preserve receiver and skip later calls/arguments/target selectors; prior source/host effects retained
lifecycle: No intermediate handler checkpoint; private captured arguments survive pause/resume without replay; RETURN before frame/counter/timer cleanup; sticky ABORT prevents later calls/publication
exact: Context-free record helper, generic typed-reference/value/result helpers, BYNAME, declared links and raw callback results remain exact; no GET_VAR/SET_VAR kinematics
excluded: Field-set changes/rename, resources, builtin/user interchange, BOOLEAN/numeric, REAL-to-integral, logical reshape, implicit context, native ABI/controller equivalence and public strict mode
persistence: Concrete data/schema and serializable supplied model context only; no private references, handlers, callbacks or suspended execution
supersedes: Older blanket model-backed STRUCTURE field and record-terminal exclusions under the existing explicit scalar model contract
